items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: That's the two men that we all joined together, was Henry Russ and Gilbert Jung. We all joined the Navy, the Navy band the same day.

ctx.x: Harold Dejean was in one of those bands.

Harold Dejean was in our same unit. Harold Dejean. Gilbert Jung, Henry Russ. That's all the fellas from this. That's the two men that we all joined together, was Henry Russ and Gilbert Jung. We all joined the Navy, the Navy band the same day. And from that time on, well, we just got out of the Navy. I'm trying to think now. I came back in the field and played several... did some funeral work with Peter Bocca and them. I think at that time it was called the brass band. It was considered the onward, part of the…

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: You see, I might, right now, I know Henry Ross played with the band.

ctx.x: Who else was in that band that you remember?
You see, I might, right now, I know Henry Ross played with the band. Yeah, now you're coming the right way. Yeah. You're coming here, that's Peter Bocard.
We haven't told Peter Bocard, if we're going to go see him right way.
